execution: canonical collector connected locally; production signal and scheduled execution not verified
trigger: explicit owner action for each recipe step; observer reads aggregates without executing
calendar: existing observer every 30 minutes during its bounded window; existing maintenance at least hourly
expected_signal: persistent isolation lock, drained previous attempts, quantified recent_visible proof, no retry or interval violation
normal_exclusions: no recipe with fresh explicit none
symptom: uncertain or failed step, incomplete proof, inconsistent lock, minimum interval violation, stale or unavailable observation
diagnostic: closed aggregate states and counts only; no owner, profile, album, page, device, token or message
repair: fix scoped evidence or code; do not launch, retry, resume, cancel jobs or change permissions from this probe
release: wait for idle; retain tasks and definitions; scheduler disabled and future boundary, explicit later restart
rollback: restore previous maintenance modules and exact collector preimage; preserve recipe locks, receipts, attempts and quota
illustrated_template: existing StoryFX application logo and incident template; no private recipe contents
validation: synthetic signal, threshold, privacy and two-line integration tests; real Android execution not verified
notifications: existing shared maximum one WhatsApp per two hours; silent resolution
